name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for a radio station app

sdks.name: radio_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of radio/dart/install.py at agent@7c3dddb; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: A radio app's home IS the player, so this SDK provides the entry page. Declares StationsTable at schema version 17; one row for a single-station app, many for a multi-station one.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/dart/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates, AppStyle, the splash and no-connection pages, and the AppDatabase radio_sdk registers StationsTable into.

sdks.name: comms_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of comms/dart/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Push notifications. The lineage this app came from used OneSignal directly; comms_sdk replaces that.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._comment: Listenership telemetry. The telemetry CLIENT lives in base_sdk (TelemetryClient.track / logError, gateway cmds tenant.api.track_event / tenant.api.log_frontend_error); telemetry_sdk (core/telemetry/dart) ships no client of its own — it composes on top and injects delivery policy through the TelemetryClient.configure transport seam. Radio listening is accumulated locally in the app's Drift database (radio_sdk's listen_daily_totals aggregates) and flushed on cold start as one radio_listen_daily summary per station-day, so listener figures are daily aggregates, not live tune-in counts; the frappe side keeps src/telemetry with the api_error_log and client_usage_event doctypes. Pin = sha256 of core telemetry/dart/install.py as bootstrapped, same pattern as desktop_sdk's entry.

sdks.name: promotions_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of promotions/dart/install.py at commerce@07427e3; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Ad mediation. Disabled by default: the station this was built for runs with ads off (showADS false), so enable per app rather than per template.

sdks.name: desktop_sdk
sdks._comment: TEMPORARY (desktop testing convenience, revert candidate): added to every app profile so all composed apps pull desktop support and can be viewed/tested on desktop. Pin = sha256 of hardware desktop/dart/install.py at main head 84aa6ed, same value as supacharge.json's entry.

sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.
